HOW IT WORKS

Follow the money.
Understand the model.

Three connected parts: charging activity, company participation and your weekly account illustration.

OPERATING ACTIVITY

A driver pays for a charging session.

In the proposed model, charging fees generate business revenue. Electricity, equipment, site costs and other expenses would be deducted before any distributable proceeds are known.

Charging payments − operating costs
The demo is not connected to station payment or operating data.
TWO DIFFERENT PERCENTAGES

Company share
and plan rate.

The 43% figure and the weekly rates describe different parts of the model. They are not interchangeable.

43%

Company participation assumption

A proposed interest in a network. Its scope and ownership documents are not verified. It does not mean 43% of US charging stations.

3–11.2%

Illustrative weekly plan rates

Applied to the demo amount once per week. These figures are not derived from the performance of the public stations shown.

A SINGLE-WEEK EXAMPLE

$250 × 3% = $7.50

One $250 demo allocation in the Single plan. No compounding. No extra payment per vehicle.
